purpose: Canonical feeding manifest for the joint H(z)+DESI DR2 BAO+fσ8+CMB-shift likelihood, binding semantic source identity to the exact bytes consumed by execution.
claim_boundary: Only committed, traceable local inputs are listed. Source identity, derived materialization and execution bytes are distinct. Missing external full products are not fabricated.

inputs.notes: Independent cosmic-chronometer subset used by the joint likelihood to avoid reusing BAO-derived H(z) points alongside the BAO likelihood.
inputs.canonical_source_fields: parent source resolved from canonical_observational_sources_manifest by parent_source_id; execution bytes verified independently

inputs.notes: The joint route consumes the committed DESI DR2 primary table, which is a distinct source contract from the legacy real_bao table.
Real fσ8/RSD compilation materialized from literature tables; replaces synthetic smooth growth fixture in the joint real route.
Planck 2018 shift-parameter summary stored locally with the committed covariance used by the joint likelihood.

failsafe.rollback: If a downstream check fails after output replacement, restore the paired *.bak artifact written beside the output file.

source_resolution_policy: Resolve source_id against canonical_observational_sources_manifest. execution_path and execution_sha256 bind the bytes actually consumed. If execution bytes differ from the canonical source bytes, a parent_source_id plus deterministic derivation contract is required; source equivalence must never be inferred from axis equivalence alone.
